description: Fetch a web page and split its main content into heading-aware, token-bounded chunks for RAG/embeddings. Each chunk has its heading path and token count.

include_tables.description: Keep tables as Markdown tables. Default true.

overlap_tokens.description: Tokens of overlap between chunks, 0-1024. Default 50.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL, at most 2048 characters.

name: chunk_url
title: Chunk web page for RAG
